Image, Image Gallery or Schematic

Source: R/figure-plots-images.R
PlotImage.Rd

Draws one raster image, a gallery of images, or a schematic of shapes.

Usage

PlotImage(
  data,
  row = NULL,
  row_levels = NULL,
  tile_mm = 10,
  view_gap_mm = 0.36,
  field_gap_mm = 1.8,
  row_pitch_mm = 11,
  column_labels = NULL,
  header_size = 4.6,
  header_colour = "muted",
  header_gap_mm = 0.5,
  row_labels = NULL,
  cross = list(colour = "#FFD54F", size = 3.5, linewidth = 0.5),
  corner = NULL,
  scale_bar = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  total = NULL,
  title_size = 5.6,
  title_gap_mm = 4.5,
  interpolate = TRUE,
  style = ManuscriptStyle()
)

Arguments

data

An array/matrix, a CompositeFields() result or a SchematicShapes() result.

row

Column of the gallery info defining gallery rows; NULL gives one row per field.

row_levels

Optional order of the row values.

tile_mm, view_gap_mm, field_gap_mm, row_pitch_mm

Gallery geometry.

column_labels

Optional header texts per view (repeated for every field of the widest row) with header_size and header_colour.

header_size, header_colour, header_gap_mm

Header text settings.

row_labels

Optional list of row-label lines, each a list with column (info column) or map (named list from the row value), dy (fraction of the tile height from the bottom), size, colour, bold, replace (named list of text substitutions) and x_mm (position relative to the panel's left edge; negative is left of it); hjust aligns the text.

cross

Draw a centre cross on every tile (list with colour, size points, linewidth points) or NULL.

corner

Optional list with column, view, size, colour: text in the top-left corner of tiles of that view.

scale_bar

Optional list: length (physical units), pixel_size, view, linewidth, colour, which ("first" tile only or "row": first tile of every row).

title

Optional gallery title placed above the column headers; {n} is replaced by the number of fields shown and {total} by the number of rows of total.

total

Optional data frame counted for {total}.

title_size, title_gap_mm

Title size (points) and distance above the tiles (mm).

interpolate

Smooth raster scaling.

style

A ManuscriptStyle() object.

Value

A 'grid' grob.

Details

  • A single image (RGB array or grey matrix with values in 0-1) fills the panel box with optional centre cross, scale bar and corner label.

  • A CompositeFields() result is laid out as a gallery: one gallery row per value of row (or per field), each field's views side by side, in absolute millimetres from the top-left of the panel box: tiles of tile_mm, view_gap_mm between the views of a field, field_gap_mm between fields and row_pitch_mm from row to row. Column headers, row labels (several lines, from columns of the fields' rows or a label map), centre crosses, corner labels and a scale bar are optional.

  • A SchematicShapes() result is drawn in its own coordinates with equal aspect.
